questions.question: What is the circulatory system?
questions.answer: The circulatory system is the body system that transports blood, oxygen, nutrients, and waste throughout the body.

questions.question: The heart is the main organ of the circulatory system.
Which blood vessel carries blood away from the heart?
Fill in the blank: The heart has ______ chambers.
What is the function of blood?
questions.answer: Blood transports oxygen, nutrients, hormones, and waste products throughout the body.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the organ shown.
Which image represents an artery?
Veins carry blood back to the heart.
Fill in the blank: Tiny blood vessels that connect arteries and veins are called ______.
Which part of the blood carries oxygen?
What is the function of the heart?
questions.answer: It pumps blood throughout the body.

questions.question: The circulatory system helps remove waste products from the body.
Observe the image and identify the blood vessel.
Which image shows blood circulation?
Explain the difference between arteries and veins.
questions.answer: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, while veins carry blood back to the heart.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Blood is pumped by the ______.
White blood cells help fight infections.
Which blood component helps in clotting?
Why is the circulatory system important?
questions.answer: It delivers oxygen and nutrients to cells and removes waste products.

questions.question: Explain how the heart and blood vessels work together.
questions.answer: The heart pumps blood through arteries to the body, and veins return the blood back to the heart.
